description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance, represented as a score with a temperature setting of 0.5, on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests for several language models. The horizontal axis displays the model names—Llama-3.3 70B Instruct, Claude 3 Sonnet, Qwen 2.5 14b-Instruct, GPT 4o, GPT 4o-mini, Qwen 2.5 72b-Instruct, Gemini 1.5 Flash, Gemini Pro 1.5, and Phi-4—listed alphabetically. The vertical axis represents the average score, labeled as “Average score (temperature = 0.5)”, with a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each model’s performance is represented by a pair of light blue and dark blue bars. The light blue bar represents the “Small model” and the dark blue bar represents the larger model. The Llama-3.3 70B Instruct model has a light blue bar with a height of approximately 66.4 and a dark blue bar with a height of approximately 74.8. The tallest bars, representing Phi-4, reach heights of approximately 91.8 for the light blue bar and 89.8 for the dark blue bar. All bars include error bars indicating variance. The bars are arranged alphabetically by model name, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
